name: B10-0246/2025 – After § 15 – Am 25
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the old challenges and new commercial practices in the internal market
part_text: 15a. Stresses the need, in the current context of high inflation in the energy and food sectors, and as highlighted in the 2025 Consumer Conditions Scoreboard, to reduce the financial burden on consumers and businesses, particularly owing to the EU regulatory framework resulting from the European Green Deal; strongly calls for the adoption of targeted legislative measures to protect consumers and businesses against excessive energy costs and speculative manipulation;
